projectName: GeoMine — NWIS Drilling Risk & Spatial Intelligence
projectDescription: GeoMine is an AI-powered drilling risk platform (NWIS) that combines real-time telemetry analysis, ML-based stuck-pipe prediction, RAG-based historical intelligence, OCR document ingestion, and GIS spatial filtering to help engineers identify and mitigate downhole hazards during oil and gas well drilling.
keyFeatures: ML-based stuck pipe risk scoring using scikit-learn with 5 telemetry features (depth, ROP, RPM, torque, WOB)
GIS spatial filtering using Haversine distance to identify nearby offset wells within a configurable radius
RAG-based historical intelligence with in-memory and pgvector backends, powered by Gemini embeddings
OCR document ingestion pipeline (PDF/DOCX/XLSX) using PyMuPDF, Tesseract, and Ollama/Gemini LLM extraction
Real-time WebSocket telemetry stream with stick-slip (MSE) detection via physics engine
Human-in-the-loop (HITL) mitigation queue for engineer review and approval of AI-generated mitigation plans
NPT (Non-Productive Time) financial analytics engine comparing current vs. historical offset well costs
Streamlit dashboard with live rig simulator, GIS map, analog well matching, and natural language knowledge search
FastAPI backend with Pydantic-validated input/output schemas and async Gemini AI generation
PostgreSQL + PostGIS backend with auto-seeding via Docker Compose
publicApiSurface: POST /api/analyze_risk — core orchestrator: ML risk + historical context + GIS spatial filter
POST /api/generate_ai_summary — async Gemini AI explanation generation
POST /api/search_knowledge — RAG-powered natural language drilling knowledge search
POST /api/ingest_report — structured JSON text ingestion into historical events DB
PATCH /api/ocr_correction — human correction feedback loop for OCR extractions
POST /api/analyze_npt — NPT financial analytics vs historical offset wells
POST /api/environmental_risk — environmental and underground infrastructure risk assessment
POST /api/mitigation/queue — queue an AI-generated mitigation plan for HITL review
GET /api/mitigation/pending — list pending engineer review items
POST /api/mitigation/approve/{queue_id} — approve a queued mitigation plan
WebSocket /ws/telemetry/{well_id} — real-time telemetry stream with physics analysis
analyze_well(events, nearby_well_ids, current_depth, formation, depth_tolerance) — Historical Intelligence Engine entry point
RAGRetrievalService(events, provider, backend, auto_prepare) — RAG retrieval with in_memory or pgvector backend
calculate_mse_and_stick_slip(telemetry_window) — Physics engine: stick-slip and MSE detection
GeminiProvider — LLM provider with sync/async .generate() and .generate_async()
HistoricalQueryService.answer_query(question, nearby_well_ids, top_k, generate_answer) — NLP query to historical intelligence
